SELECT ir.id as roleId, ir.role_name as roleName, ir.enabled as status, ir.remark, IF(ir.enabled = 1, '启用中', '已禁用') as roleStatusName, ir.create_time as createTime, -- 关联用户ID聚合结果，若角色没有关联用户则显示NULL if(ur.user_ids is null,0,ur.user_ids ) as userCount FROM ins_role ir -- 左连接用户角色关联表的聚合结果 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, count(1) AS user_ids -- 聚合同一角色的所有用户ID FROM ins_user_role GROUP BY role_id ) ur ON ir.id = ur.role_id -- 通过role_id关联 WHERE 1=1
and ir.role_name like concat('%',#{model.searchKeyword},'%')
ORDER BY ir.create_time desc

SELECT ir.id as roleId, ir.role_name as roleName, ir.enabled as status, ir.remark, IF(ir.enabled = 1, '启用中', '已禁用') as roleStatusName, ir.create_time as createTime, -- 关联用户ID聚合结果，若角色没有关联用户则显示NULL ur.user_ids as userIdsStr FROM ins_role ir -- 左连接用户角色关联表的聚合结果 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, GROUP_CONCAT(user_id SEPARATOR ',') AS user_ids -- 聚合同一角色的所有用户ID FROM ins_user_role GROUP BY role_id ) ur ON ir.id = ur.role_id -- 通过role_id关联 WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY ir.create_time desc
